description: Preserved per-seed evidence for the 1,000-seed replication of the flat-fee versus recommended-construction pairing at low and severe-congestion load. The recommended construction is the adopted configuration: 0.75 standard target, 10-block processed-block standard window, age-escape reset at certification. Statistics are paired mean differences (recommended minus flat fee) with two-sided 95% paired-t confidence intervals; ratio metrics are reported in percentage points.
